name: com.evosim.farm
description: The farm out of Unity: Core's World and Evosim.Dynamics stepped together (Simulation and its partials), the environment binding, the manifest, the rows and the report. Consumed by the Unity project as a local package beside Core and Dynamics so that the theatre can replay a dynamics-engine recording by running the farm's own loop inside the Editor rather than a second copy of it. Nothing here touches UnityEngine; Program.Main is compiled as ordinary code and never entered in the Editor.
